issues.failure_explanation: The decomposition splits the integral over [0,t] using intervals [0,h], [h,τ_t^h-h], and [τ_t^h-h,t]. These partition [0,t] only when h ≤ τ_t^h−h, i.e., τ_t^h ≥ 2h (equivalently t ≥ 2h). For h < t < 2h one has τ_t^h = h and τ_t^h−h = 0, so the intervals are [0,h] and [0,t], which overlap on [0,h] and double-count that subinterval. For t ≤ h the first interval [0,h] extends beyond t and the integrand p_α(t−s,·) is undefined for s > t. The claimed identity Error = Δ₁+…+Δ₆ is therefore incorrect for t < 2h.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict the Δ₁–Δ₆ decomposition to the regime t ≥ 2h and handle t < 2h separately by bounding the Duhamel error integral directly using Aronson-type upper bounds, yielding O(t^{(α−1)/α}) p̄_α(t,y−x), which is within the theorem's bound C(1+t^{−β/α})h^{γ/α} p̄_α(t,y−x).
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Theorem 1 has a gap for time regimes t < 2h. The theorem's stated bound is still provable in this regime via a direct Aronson-bound estimate, but the presented decomposition does not cover it.
issues.title: Error decomposition does not partition the integration interval for t < 2h
issues.why_classification: A routine case split on t/h preserves every substantive claim and guarantee. No new nontrivial lemma or construction is needed; the small-t case falls under a direct Aronson bound already available in the paper.

issues.failure_explanation: The intermediate estimate claims ∫_h^t s^{−γ/α}(t−s)^{−1/α} ds ≲ 1 with a constant depending only on (d,b,α,T). By the Beta function, ∫_0^t s^{−γ/α}(t−s)^{−1/α} ds = t^{−β/α} B((1−β)/α,(α−1)/α), which diverges as t → 0 since β > 0. For example, at t = 2h the integral is ≈ C·h^{−β/α} → ∞ as h → 0. The correct bound on Δ₂ is |Δ₂| ≲ p̄_α h^{γ/α} t^{−β/α}, not |Δ₂| ≲ p̄_α h^{γ/α}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the claimed bound |Δ₂| ≲ p̄_α h^{γ/α} with |Δ₂| ≲ p̄_α h^{γ/α} t^{−β/α}. This corrected bound is absorbed by the theorem's factor (1+t^{−β/α})h^{γ/α} p̄_α in the final assembly.
issues.overall_effect: The intermediate bound (maj-D2-mainthm) is too strong by a factor t^{−β/α}. The corrected bound h^{γ/α} t^{−β/α} p̄_α is still dominated by the theorem's overall factor (1+t^{−β/α})h^{γ/α} p̄_α, so the main theorem's conclusion is not affected.
issues.title: Δ₂ integral bound is incorrectly claimed to be uniformly bounded
issues.why_classification: A short, local correction to one intermediate bound preserves every substantive claim and guarantee. The main theorem's stated rate and scope are unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: After bounding Δ₁, Δ₂, Δ₄, Δ₅, Δ₆, the remaining term is Δ₃, whose integrand uses the kernel ∇_y p_α(t−s, y−·) and whose integration domain is [h, τ_t^h−h]. The 'Gathering estimates' step silently replaces Δ₃ with an integral whose integrand uses the kernel ∇_y p_α(t−τ_s^h, y−·) and whose domain is [h, t]. These two expressions differ by (i) a time-sensitivity term on [h, τ_t^h−h] arising from ∇p(t−s) − ∇p(t−τ_s^h) and (ii) an additional contribution on [τ_t^h−h, t]. Neither is bounded in the proof. The replacement is needed for the subsequent Gronwall–Volterra step to apply, since the convolution p̄_α(τ_s^h,·)∗p̄_α(t−τ_s^h,·) yields p̄_α(t,·), whereas p̄_α(τ_s^h,·)∗p̄_α(t−s,·) does not. The missing step requires bounding both extra terms (using time-Hölder and cancellation estimates similar to those for Δ₄₂ and Δ₆) and showing they are dominated by the Gronwall integral.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Prove that Δ₃ equals the stated remaining integral plus terms bounded by (i) ∫_h^{τ_t^h−h} f(τ_s^h) h/(t−τ_s^h)^{1+1/α} ds (time sensitivity, absorbable into the Gronwall integral since h ≤ t−τ_s^h) and (ii) a last-step cancellation estimate on [τ_t^h−h, t] analogous to the Δ₆ bound. Both use techniques already developed in the proof.
issues.overall_effect: The Gronwall–Volterra step that concludes the proof of Theorem 1 rests on an unproven reformulation of Δ₃. The proof of Theorem 1 has a gap at the final step, though the reformulated integral is likely correct once the missing estimates are supplied.
issues.title: Unjustified replacement of Δ₃ by a different remaining integral in the Gronwall step
issues.why_classification: The repair requires a contained nontrivial argument (bounding two additional terms via adapted versions of existing estimates) but no new global proof architecture or major weakening of the result. The stated rate and scope are preserved.
